text: Hitting Table Plus’s two-tab free limit? Meet Table eye cue.
A free, open-source database client for Mac. Open another table, another query, and keep your work in view.
Coming from D Beaver? Try the same everyday task here. Browse your data, inspect relationships, and write your S Q L.
Which paid orders haven’t shipped? Follow payments to shipments, review the query, and run it. Two matching orders. There’s your answer.
Want help writing S Q L? Use your own A I key for a draft. Review it before you run it. A I is optional.
Using a coding agent? Inspect the database queries it sends through Table eye cue.
Get the free Mac developer preview at Table eye cue dot Ideolyst dot com.
